Modulator_Type: Type-II / Helix-alphaC Displacement Allosteric RNase Attenuator (KIRA / PAIR)
Showcase_and_Upgraded_Compounds: Showcase: KIRA6 (CID 73425700) -> Upgrade to: KIRA8 / AMG-18 (CID 118721244, CHEMBL3665060) & PAIR partial antagonists (G-1749 / G-9807)
Potency_and_Selectivity_Audit: KIRA6 inhibits IRE1a oligomerization & RNase in Akita mice (PMID 25018104), but is a promiscuous kinase inhibitor hitting c-KIT (Kd 10.8 uM, cellular IC50 nanomolar; PMID 30931942), LYN (PMID 40786050), and p38. Next-gen KIRA8 (AMG-18) is mono-selective (IC50 ~5 nM) and reverses diabetes in Akita & NOD mice (PMID 28380378).
Human_Genetics_gnomAD_and_KO: gnomAD LoF oe = 0.34 (upperBin 1, LoF-intolerant); DepMap mean +0.053 (7/1258 lines). Mouse Ern1-/- is embryonic lethal, and constitutive beta-cell Ern1 deletion impairs proinsulin folding. Crucially, helix-alphaC partial antagonists ('PAIRs', PMID 34556859) block hyper-oligomeric pro-apoptotic RIDD while preserving dimeric adaptive XBP1s splicing.
Pancreas_and_BetaCell_Expression: GTEx Pancreas 18.3 TPM; HPA Pancreas 63.0 nTPM; human beta-cell scRNA-seq 3.86 nCPM, islet endocrine 31.76 nCPM.
Structural_Druggability_PDB: 24 human IRE1a kinase/RNase co-crystals: 4U6R (2.50 A), 4YZ9 (2.46 A, GSK2850163), 6URC (2.20 A), 6W39 (1.74 A), 6W3K (2.08 A), 7BMK (1.85 A, PAIR partial antagonist; PMID 34556859). Best non-covalent druggability in the campaign [FACT].
Safety_and_Translational_Verdict: GO / TOP PRIORITY (#1 Structural & Biological Track) — Allosterically breaking IRE1a hyper-oligomers or using PAIR partial antagonists stops insulin mRNA degradation (RIDD) and terminal apoptosis while sparing basal XBP1s. Replace off-target KIRA6 with selective KIRA8 (AMG-18) and 7BMK PAIR scaffolds.

Proposed_Node: ATF6a (Trafficking / Activation) -> True Target: ER PDIs (P4HB / PDIA4 / PDIA3)
True_Molecular_Target_Gene: P4HB / PDIA1 (UniProt P07237, ENSG00000185624) + PDIA4 + PDIA3 [NOT a direct ATF6 ligand]
Modulator_Type: Metabolically Activated Quinone-Methide Covalent PDI Modifier
Showcase_and_Upgraded_Compounds: Showcase: AA147 (CID 882909, CHEMBL4208316) + Next-gen phenylhydrazone AA263 (PMID 41586813)
Potency_and_Selectivity_Audit: TARGET DECONVOLUTION ALERT: AA147 does NOT bind ATF6 directly [FACT]. Its 2-amino-p-cresol ring undergoes ER-oxidative metabolic activation to a reactive quinone methide that covalently modifies catalytic cysteines on ER protein disulfide isomerases (PDIA1/P4HB, PDIA4/ERp72, PDIA3/ERp57), shifting ATF6 from disulfide-bonded oligomers to monomers that traffic to the Golgi (EC50 ~1-5 uM; PMID 27435961, 30084354, 37523656).
Human_Genetics_gnomAD_and_KO: ATF6: gnomAD LoF oe = 0.63 (tolerant; human biallelic LoF causes achromatopsia; PMID 29440509). P4HB (PDIA1): gnomAD LoF oe = 0.38, DepMap mean -0.100; mouse beta-cell Pdia1 KO impairs proinsulin disulfide maturation. Adaptive ATF6f activation boosts BiP (HSPA5) and ER folding capacity without triggering CHOP apoptosis.
Pancreas_and_BetaCell_Expression: P4HB (PDIA1) is the #2 highest-expressed gene in human pancreas (GTEx 960.6 TPM; HPA 2,108.3 nTPM) and abundant in beta cells; ATF6 is 10.3 TPM in pancreas.
Structural_Druggability_PDB: ATF6 has 0 experimental PDB structures (intrinsically disordered bZIP + luminal domain). P4HB (PDIA1) has 14 PDB structures (4EKZ 2.51 A, 6I7S 2.50 A, 8GDY 2.05 A). Direct non-covalent docking to ATF6 is invalid; structure-based modeling must target PDI catalytic CXXC domains.
Safety_and_Translational_Verdict: GO WITH PRODRUG CAVEAT (#2 Biological Track) — Adaptive ATF6 activation in EndoC-bH1 under GLTx is highly protective, but AA147's quinone-methide covalent modification of PDIA1 (which itself folds proinsulin!) requires carefully titrated dosing (1-5 uM) so proinsulin disulfide maturation is not over-inhibited.

Potency_and_Selectivity_Audit: 4u8C IC50 ~76 nM (cell EC50 1-5 uM; PMID 22315414); STF-083010 (unstable imine prodrug hydrolyzing in aqueous media to active aldehyde; PMID 21081713); MKC-8866 IC50 0.29 uM (Phase 1/2 clinical lead ORIN1001; PMID 25164867). Forms solvent-shielded Schiff base with catalytic Lys907 in RNase domain [FACT].
Human_Genetics_gnomAD_and_KO: gnomAD LoF oe = 0.34 (ERN1). Complete catalytic RNase inhibition blocks both toxic RIDD and adaptive XBP1s splicing; chronic loss of XBP1s compromises basal BiP/ERAD maintenance in secretory beta cells.
Pancreas_and_BetaCell_Expression: GTEx Pancreas 18.3 TPM; HPA Pancreas 63.0 nTPM; human beta-cell scRNA-seq 3.86 nCPM, islet endocrine 31.76 nCPM.
Structural_Druggability_PDB: 26 human ERN1 PDBs + 3 murine HAA co-crystals: 4PL3 (2.90 A, MKC9989 covalent Lys907 adduct), 4PL4 (3.00 A, OICR464), 4PL5 (3.40 A, OICR573; PMID 25164867). Shallow polar RNase site requires covalent aldehyde warhead.
Safety_and_Translational_Verdict: CAUTION / TOOL-GRADE (Warhead & XBP1s Liability) — Aldehyde warhead carries systemic off-target lysine Schiff-base reactivity, and full RNase block abolishes adaptive XBP1s. Prioritize MKC-8866 (ORIN1001) over unstable STF-083010 in wet-lab assays; requires covalent Lys907 docking.

Potency_and_Selectivity_Audit: PERK IC50 0.4-6 nM [FACT]. CRITICAL OFF-TARGET ALERT: GSK2606414 & GSK2656157 inhibit RIPK1 (IC50 ~20 nM, blocking TNF necroptosis independently of PERK; PMID 28452996) and c-KIT (Kd 664 nM; PMID 30931942) at concentrations below cellular PERK IC50. HC-5770 (AMG-44) cleanly spares RIPK1 & c-KIT (PMID 38889047).
Human_Genetics_gnomAD_and_KO: gnomAD LoF oe = 0.44 (moderate constraint); DepMap mean -0.042 (16/1257 lines). Human biallelic EIF2AK3 LoF causes Wolcott-Rallison syndrome (neonatal permanent insulin-dependent diabetes + exocrine pancreatic atrophy; PMID 42945448). Mouse Perk-/- causes postnatal beta-cell loss & exocrine insufficiency, whereas Perk+/- improves HFD GSIS (PMID 37956968).
Pancreas_and_BetaCell_Expression: GTEx Pancreas 18.3 TPM; HPA Pancreas 20.1 nTPM, heavily enriched in pancreatic acinar cells (394.5 nCPM) > endocrine islet cells.
Structural_Druggability_PDB: 15 human PDB structures: 4G31 (2.28 A, GSK2606414 co-crystal), 4M7I (2.34 A, GSK2656157 co-crystal), 4X7K (1.80 A, aminopyridine/quinazoline series), 8EQE (2.56 A). High-quality druggable kinase pocket [FACT].
Safety_and_Translational_Verdict: NARROW TI / HIGH ON-TARGET PANCREATIC TOXICITY — Full PERK inhibition phenocopies Wolcott-Rallison syndrome and causes rapid pancreatic acinar atrophy + runaway proinsulin proteotoxicity (PMID 23333938, 41686355). Only ultra-low-dose partial attenuation (20-50 nM, PMID 37670417, 42155730) or T1D PD-L1 stabilization (HC-5770, PMID 38889047) is viable; drop GSK2606414/2656157 in favor of HC-5770.

UPR_Branch: ATF6a -> ER Retention (Loss of Adaptive Branch)
Proposed_Node: ATF6a (Trafficking Inhibition) -> True Target: ATF6a-ABCD3 Neomorphic Tether
Modulator_Type: Molecular Glue / Inter-Organelle Neomorphic Tether (ER ATF6a <-> Peroxisomal ABCD3)
Potency_and_Selectivity_Audit: MECHANISM & DIRECTIONALITY ALERT: Ceapin-A7 is a molecular glue that tethers the cytosolic N-terminal domain of ER-resident ATF6a to the transmembrane region of peroxisomal transporter ABCD3 (PMP70; PMID 27435960, 31149896). In beta cells under GLTx, ATF6 is the ADAPTIVE pro-survival chaperone branch — inhibiting ATF6 sensitizes beta cells to ER-stress apoptosis (PMID 27435960, 34163039).
Human_Genetics_gnomAD_and_KO: ATF6 LoF in mice causes hepatic steatosis & increased sensitivity to ER stress/cell death (IMPC); ABCD3 LoF (oe = 0.39) causes hepatomegaly and peroxisomal bile-acid/VLCFA defects.
Pancreas_and_BetaCell_Expression: ATF6 GTEx Pancreas 10.3 TPM; ABCD3 GTEx Pancreas 9.2 TPM (Liver 23.5 TPM).
Structural_Druggability_PDB: ATF6: 0 PDB structures (AlphaFold only). ABCD3: 4 cryo-EM structures (8Z0F 3.27 A, 8Z9X 2.96 A, 9NGJ 3.13 A). Ternary ATF6(2-150)-Ceapin-A7-ABCD3 interface has no experimental crystal structure.
Safety_and_Translational_Verdict: NEGATIVE / COUNTER-SCREEN CONTROL ONLY (Do Not Advance as Therapeutic Lead) — Blocking adaptive ATF6 aggravates ER stress and triggers apoptosis in stressed beta cells. Use Ceapin-A7 strictly as a phenotypic negative control (or to reverse AA147 rescue) in the EndoC-bH1 UPR reporter assay.

Modulator_Type: Allosteric eIF2B Activator / State-Dependent ISR Attenuator
Potency_and_Selectivity_Audit: EC50 ~5 nM [FACT]. Bypasses PERK kinase completely by allosterically stabilizing decameric eIF2B against eIF2a-P inhibition. Selectively relieves mild/moderate translational attenuation without completely abolishing cytoprotective eIF2a-P braking under extreme stress, and has zero RIPK1 or c-KIT off-target activity (PMID 41595662).
Human_Genetics_gnomAD_and_KO: Avoids Wolcott-Rallison complete PERK-null pancreatic acinar necrosis in preclinical models because high eIF2a-P levels outcompete ISRIB.
Pancreas_and_BetaCell_Expression: Ubiquitously expressed in human beta cells and islets.
Structural_Druggability_PDB: Multiple high-resolution human eIF2B-ISRIB cryo-EM structures (e.g. 6CAJ, 7L7G).
Safety_and_Translational_Verdict: RECOMMENDED ORTHOGONAL CONTROL for Track 1 — Pair with HC-5770 in EndoC-bH1 GLTx assays to separate true ISR translational relief from PERK-specific luminal/RIPK1 effects.

UPR_Branch: Cytosolic ABL1/ABL2 -> ER Membrane IRE1a Scaffold
Proposed_Node: ABL1 / ABL2 (Upstream Rheostat of IRE1a RNase)
Potency_and_Selectivity_Audit: Directly connects to our completed Imatinib Beta-Cell Target ID campaign (RIC-412): ABL1 (Kd 1 nM) and ABL2 (Kd 6-13 nM, 92.8 nCPM in human islets) translocate to the ER membrane during stress to scaffold & hyperactivate IRE1a RNase (PMID 28380378). Inhibiting ABL1/2 attenuates pro-apoptotic IRE1a RIDD upstream without touching basal IRE1a catalytic pockets.
Human_Genetics_gnomAD_and_KO: Clinically validated in Phase 2 recent-onset T1D trial (imatinib 400 mg QD preserved beta-cell C-peptide; PMID 34214479).
Pancreas_and_BetaCell_Expression: Human beta-cell scRNA-seq: ABL1 5.80 nCPM, ABL2 9.42 nCPM (islet endocrine 80.8 & 92.8 nCPM).
Structural_Druggability_PDB: 2HYY (ABL1-imatinib, Vina -11.19 kcal/mol, MD drift 0.66 A), 3GVU (ABL2-imatinib, Vina -11.84 kcal/mol, MD drift 0.73 A).
Safety_and_Translational_Verdict: CLINICAL BENCHMARK REFERENCE — Provides a clinically validated human beta-cell reference control for IRE1a-pathway attenuation in the EndoC-bH1 GLTx reporter assay.
